programmes.d: Action superstar Jean-Claude van Damme ("Bloodsport", "Cyborg") is a veteran undercover cop posing as an inmate in a dangerously corrupt state prison.
When Army Major Susan Turner (Cobie Smulders) is framed for treason, Reacher discovers she's the target of a massive government conspiracy.
A Navy SEAL fights off airport terrorists planning to bomb the State of the Union address.
An ex-commando is pressed back into service when his daughter is kidnapped.

Denzel Washington returns to one of his signature roles in the first sequel of his career. Robert McCall serves unflinching justice for the exploited and oppressed – but how far will he go when it is someone he loves?

Harrison Ford stars as the wrongly convicted Dr. Richard Kimble, and Tommy Lee Jones is U.S. Marshal Sam Gerard, his relentless pursuer, in this intense thriller based on the hit television series of the 1960s.
A weapons expert and a prisoner join forces to avert a catastrophe.
The USS Alabama receives an unconfirmed order to launch its missiles.
A Navy navigator is shot down over enemy territory and is pursued by a secret police enforcer.

Ninjitsu master Frank Dux journeys to Hong Kong to enter the Kumite, the Olympics of martial arts, and meets a beautiful American reporter. Before long he must face Chong-Li, a vicious Korean master of Tae Kwan Do, in a climactic fight to the finish.
A former convict on parole must outwit the police to get his share of an old heist.
